title: 第3章 一道词条一条命第4章 极道小说不是这样写的
content_zh:
‘全记下了？’
低头俯视着眼前神态恭敬的少年，冯越的脸上露出一丝惊讶！
何止是他！
在周围的少年里，所有人都震惊地望着叶离！
尤其是那自称记了七成的唐简，更是不可置信到了极点！
毕竟在他的认知当中，两人同为【机敏过人】词条，自然会多分出一份心神关注，早早存了比较的心思！
二人皆是+30%悟性的【机敏过人】词条。
要是叶离记的比自己多，岂不是侧面印证了自己的愚蠢！
撞词条不可怕，谁蠢谁尴尬！
一时之间，唐简的脸色变了又变，想出声质疑但终究没有开口，而是与周围人一样就静静看着叶离表演。
“你打一套我看看！”
冯越也是有些不信，开口道。
没有废话，叶离轻轻昂首，有挂在身的他底气十足。
大步迈出人群，模仿着之前冯越的姿态那般做出抱架。
由于上辈子主播出身，早就习惯了被人注视、网暴、谩骂、开盒、阴阳、嘲笑……
所以被这几十人目不转睛的盯着，他神态如常，专心做着自己的事情。
冯越演示时的每一个细微姿态、每一段呼吸的深浅变化、每一次肌肉的发力与松弛，都在叶离脑中隐现。
“嘶~~~”
一声清晰绵长的悠长吸气声响起，打破场地的寂静。
霎时！

他的身体动了。
伴随着吸气，叶离的身躯模仿着记忆中冯越的姿态开始变化！
身躯或舒展如苍松，或蜷缩如卧龙，拧转如灵蛇！
同时每一个姿势都精准地对应着一段特定的、或深或浅的呼吸。
场中一片死寂。
所有少年都瞪大了眼睛，张着嘴，望着场中的清瘦身影。
那复杂到看一眼都觉得头晕的81段呼吸搭配81种姿态，他竟然真的分毫不差地复刻了出来？
这……真的是第一次看就能记住并做到的？
‘开出金了！’
冯越愣愣地盯着叶离的动作，眼底流露出惊叹！
分毫不差！
虽然动作生涩僵硬，宛若鹦鹉学舌般的拙劣。
但学的真踏马像！
他看的分明，叶离之前从未接触过《苍龙劲》，这绝对是第一次观看！
因为这叶离的苍龙劲完全是和自己一脉相承，就连自己练功时一些与原本不同的个人习惯动作都模仿出来。
显然，由于初学的少年分辨不出哪些是个人特色，哪些是功法原版，所以一股脑照单全收！
作为人群的焦点，叶离的感受却是与外人不同！
随着苍龙劲的功法，他能够感受到自己身躯内不一样的律动。
随着呼吸和姿态的变化，他体表薄薄的粗布麻衣下，仿佛有无数细小的活物在皮肤下游走、鼓胀、收缩！
显然，正如冯越所说。

这苍龙劲的运转正在调动全身上下500块肌肉同时淬炼。
在日常生活中，约200块肌肉会参与简单步行。
剧烈运动时，调动的肌肉数量可达400块以上。
而这苍龙劲的锻炼的效果，可比叶离前世所有的锻炼方法都要高效！
content_en:
‘Remember everything? ’
低头俯视着眼前神态恭敬的少年，冯越的脸上露出一丝惊讶！
Not just him!
Among the surrounding teenagers, everyone looked at Ye Li in shock!
尤其是那自称记了七成的唐简，更是不可置信到了极点！
After all, in his understanding, the two of them were both in the category of [excellent alertness], so they would naturally pay more attention to them, and they had already started to compare!
二人皆是+30%悟性的【机敏过人】词条。
If Ye Li remembered more than he did, wouldn't it prove his own stupidity!
It’s not scary to bump into entries, whoever is stupid will be embarrassed!
For a moment, Tang Jian's expression changed again and again. She wanted to question it but in the end she did not speak. Instead, she quietly watched Ye Li's performance like the people around her.
"You play a trick and let me see!"
Feng Yue also didn't believe it and said.
There was no nonsense, Ye Li raised his head slightly, he was full of confidence with his body.
He strode out of the crowd and made a hug imitating Feng Yue's previous posture.
Since I was born as an anchor in my previous life, I have long been accustomed to being stared at, bullied online, abused, unboxed, yin and yang, ridiculed...
So being stared at by these dozens of people, he looked as normal and concentrated on doing his own thing.
Every subtle gesture during Feng Yue's demonstration, every change in depth of breathing, and every muscle exertion and relaxation, all loomed in Ye Li's mind.
"Hiss~~~"
A clear and long inhalation sounded, breaking the silence of the venue.
Instantly!
His body moved.
As he inhaled, Ye Li's body began to change, imitating Feng Yue's posture in his memory!
The body may be stretched like a pine tree, or curled up like a crouching dragon, or twisted like a spiritual snake!
At the same time, each posture accurately corresponds to a specific period of deep or shallow breathing.
There was dead silence.
所有少年都瞪大了眼睛，张着嘴，望着场中的清瘦身影。
He actually reproduced the 81 steps of breathing and 81 postures that were so complicated that one would feel dizzy just by looking at them?
Is this... really something you can remember and do after watching it for the first time?
‘Gold is drawn! ’
Feng Yue stared blankly at Ye Li's movements, with wonder in his eyes!
Exactly!
Although the movements were jerky and stiff, it was as clumsy as a parrot.
But I learned how to step on a horse like a horse!
He could see clearly that Ye Li had never come across "Cang Long Jin" before, and this was definitely his first time watching it!
Because Ye Li's Canglong Jin is completely in line with his own, even some of his personal habits and movements that are different from his original ones are imitated.
Obviously, since the young beginners can't tell which ones are personal characteristics and which ones are the original version of the exercises, they just accept them all!
As the focus of the crowd, Ye Li's feelings are different from those of outsiders!
With Canglong Jin's skills, he could feel the different rhythms in his body.
As his breathing and posture changed, under the thin coarse linen clothes on his body, there seemed to be countless tiny living things swimming, bulging, and contracting under his skin!
Obviously, as Feng Yue said.
The operation of Canglong Jin is mobilizing 500 muscles in the whole body to be tempered at the same time.
In daily life, about 200 muscles are involved in simple walking.
During strenuous exercise, the number of muscles mobilized can reach more than 400.
And the effect of Canglongjin's training is more efficient than all the training methods used by Ye Li in his previous life!
